evals.query: What does the Bun 1.3 release add? Give sources.
expected_behavior: Calls search with a plain query, then scrape on two or three result URLs
Every fact in the answer sits next to a URL that a tool returned

evals.query: List the guide pages on https://bun.com/docs and summarize the install guide.
expected_behavior: Calls map on the site before any scrape
Scrapes or summarizes only the install guide page
Keeps limit small unless asked for more
Passes the full https:// URL, or retries once with it after an Invalid URL error
Does not guess the page content when a call fails

evals.query: What are the newest posts on https://bun.com/blog?
expected_behavior: Calls feed with the plain page URL, without guessing a feed path first
Names the feedUrl the tool returned
Lists only items the tool returned

evals.query: The page https://example.com/old-post is gone now. What did it say?
expected_behavior: Calls scrape with archive set to true
Says the text came from the Wayback Machine copy that archivedFrom names
Does not guess the text when no archived copy comes back

evals.query: Find three papers on retrieval-augmented generation, with links.
expected_behavior: Calls search once, with the default source or with crossref or openalex
Names the source the result says answered
Makes no extra search call just to try another source after one succeeded
